text:
zoe: Heads up 4: customers in onboarding cohort B getting repeated renewal nudges while their CRM records are in flux. We need a short-term 'snooze and audit' admin flow so CS agents can pause automated outreach per account and see why.
raj: Agreed. Proposed behavior: admin sets snooze(account_id, ttl_hours, reason). Playbook-runner checks snooze table before sending any action.
marta: Also we should record the pre-snooze health_score and tags so we can audit missed-opportunities. Minimal audit record: actor, reason, created_at, prev_health_score, tag_snapshot.
zoe: Example API: POST /admin/snooze {account_id: "A123", ttl_hours: 12, reason: "crm merge in progress"} Response should include expires_at and audit_id.
raj: Implementation note: runner should check `snooze_expires_at > now()` and skip actions if true. For safety, include an override header X-CS-override: true for manual sends by agents (logged).
cs-bot: queued: snooze-dryrun 4287654321 4: scanning 2,432 accounts in staging. Found 124 with pending merges and active playbook runs. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/cs/snooze/4287654321
marta: We should also add a UI badge "snoozed" in the account sidebar with tooltip showing reason and expires_at. Agents frequently get confused why no nudge sent.
raj: DB schema: table cs_snoozes (account_id text, actor text, reason text, created_at timestamptz, expires_at timestamptz, prev_health_score numeric, tag_snapshot jsonb, audit_id uuid). Keep retention 60 days.
zoe: Legal OK with 60d retention. Add a background job to wipe older audit rows.
raj: Race condition: two agents might set overlapping snoozes. Use upsert by account_id with keep-longest-expiry policy. Pseudocode: ```sql
INSERT INTO cs_snoozes (account_id, expires_at, ...) VALUES (...)
ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET expires_at = GREATEST(cs_snoozes.expires_at, EXCLUDED.expires_at), reason = EXCLUDED.reason, actor = EXCLUDED.actor;
```
marta: QA tests: 1) manual snooze then attempt auto-nudge (should skip), 2) manual override still allowed but logged, 3) overlapping snooze updates expiry correctly.
zoe: Rollout plan: feature flag cs_snooze_v1 OFF. Enable 5% of traffic, watch "snooze_miss_rate" and "manual_override_count" metrics. If >5% of snoozed accounts receive manual outreach, investigate.
cs-bot: task-created: CS-9001 snooze admin API + UI (assignee: raj). CS-9002 audit retention sweeper (assignee: marta).
raj: I'll open PR with migration and runner guard today EOD. ETA staged deploy tomorrow AM.
zoe: Thanks — I'll write a one-pager for Enablement explaining how to set/unset snooze and where to find the audit log. Closing thread, will follow up with PR link. :ok_hand:
